results.title: Digital Business Laws and Regulations USA 2025-2026
results.content: **ICLG - Digital Business Laws and Regulations** - USA Chapter covers e-commerce regulations, data protection, cybersecurity, cultural norms, brand enforcement, data centres and the cloud, trade and customs and tax treatment and more. As to all organisations, a growing number of consumer privacy state laws (e.g., the CCPA, Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), Connecticut Data Privacy and Online Monitoring Act, Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, etc.) and processing/information-specific laws (e.g., Colorado’s AI-related amendments to the CPA, Washington’s My Health My Data Act (MHMD), Illinois’ Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), New York’s Department of Financial Services Rules) may apply to fintech, retail, AI, and digital health and provide for consumer rights, limit personal data processing and sharing, require specific disclosures, require data minimisation, and include compliance obligations (e.g., cybersecurity). Further, old laws are new again, as noted above, and retailers are being faced with a brush of class actions alleging that tracking technologies require compliance with state wiretapping laws and e-commerce transactions require businesses to place limits on the processing of personal data collected online.
